P2w: At a café in San Cristóbal de las Casas, the only white man we met sat us down and grilled us so directly that he seemed like a CIA agent. Why were we there? Who were we working with? What were our plans? When were we leaving?
P16w: As part of my research I have also looked for evidence of what happened after the Escuelita. While I found information on alumni networks, people bringing practices back with them, and organizing later, I couldn't find a clear chain of somebody having been to the Escuelita, then a new communal institution being set up, and then evidence about how its members and their children actually did over time. Zapatista influence was already spreading abroad before the Escuelita, so if some institution resembles a Zapatista one later, that alone doesn't prove the Escuelita was responsible. I'm borrowing the Zapatistas' teaching method and their ambition to replicate, not claiming they already proved my whole model.
